[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Sort an Array** [LC 912 · Sort an Array](https://leetcode.com/problems/sort-an-array/){difficulty="Medium"}

This is the sorting box itself, not a problem that sorting *helps* with, so the task is to *write* a sort and choose it by the constraints. "$O(n\log n)$" rules out the quadratic sorts; "as little extra space as possible" separates merge sort ($O(n)$ buffer) from heapsort ($O(1)$); and judges for this problem typically include sorted and all-equal arrays, which is exactly where a naive quicksort turns quadratic.

[Solved in full in @sec-salgo-p1-a.]{.card-link}
